messages.text:
Work autonomously in `gamesbyian/wallgen` as **Agent 2: Typography Completion and Rendering Quality**.

Own [issue #653](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/issues/653). Read `AGENTS.md`, the current work queue, typography plan and renderer ownership contract. Inspect current main, issues and PRs before editing.

Build on merged #654–#663. Prioritize editable canonical text-on-path using existing curves and shape geometry, then valuable typography refinements: spacing, outlines, shadows, rainbow controls and multilingual shaping/font coverage.

Preserve the existing font library, private TTF/OTF system, canonical object model, worker/headless/export parity, Undo and opt-in defaults. Validate actual rendered wallpapers, complex glyphs, full-resolution export and realistic performance. Fix demonstrated rendering defects rather than rebuilding completed features.

Coordinate UI ownership with Agent 3 and avoid Agent 1's reconstruction algorithms. Implement and test on focused branches, submit qualified PRs, update #653 and plans, and continue through remaining achievable engineering work. Do not claim physical Android acceptance from browser evidence.
